reasoning: This is a deployable service for KV-Cache management in the llm-d inference platform. It exposes a gRPC IndexerService (GetPodScores RPC) for KV-cache-aware routing, ingests KVEvents from vLLM pods to maintain a real-time index of KV-block locality, and includes a UDS tokenizer sidecar service. The project has a Dockerfile that builds a standalone Go binary, deploy/ manifests for Kubernetes deployment, gRPC protobuf service definitions (indexer and tokenizer), and a Helm chart (vllm-setup-helm/). While it also contains Go library packages (pkg/kvcache, pkg/kvevents, pkg/tokenization) that can be imported, the primary purpose is to run as a deployed service alongside vLLM pods — receiving cache events, maintaining the block index, and serving scoring requests to schedulers.
